llm_top3.reasoning: BEN pairs the top quant rank with genuinely strong fundamental news — record $1.8T AUM, broad net inflows across every asset class, an EPS beat and margin expansion ahead of plan. ARES offers the cleanest secular story with record $36B quarterly fundraising, 17% AUM growth and near-universal analyst target hikes. I deviate from WY and AEE (ranks 2-3) for PBI: WY's Q3 guide is for lower EBITDA amid housing weakness, and AEE is a solid but modest utility, while PBI combines raised guidance, an EPS beat, $201M of debt paydown and an active second-phase strategic review that explicitly includes a full sale — a discrete catalyst with asymmetric upside. I avoided EIX and ES on wildfire/charge-driven negative news despite their utility-sector momentum.
